title: Tucuvi, which develops AI agents that check in with patients and escalate cases to human teams when needed, raised a $20M Series A, led by Cathay and Leadwind (John Reynolds/Tech.eu)
summary: John Reynolds / Tech.eu: Tucuvi, which develops AI agents that check in with patients and escalate cases to human teams when needed, raised a $20M Series A, led by Cathay and Leadwind — Tucuvi was co-founded by Maria Gonzalez, whose mother passed away after a reported hospital administration error.
